items.title: Lula wins fourth term in dramatic Brazil election comeback
items.description: The left-wing incumbent president had lost the first round to right-wing challenger Flávio Bolsonaro.

items.title: Celebrations in Serbia after veteran ruler Vučić loses election to student-led protest movement
items.description: The populist right-wing leader of 12 years says it is "clear" his party has lost the vote billed as a referendum on the country's future.

items.title: Trump administration illegally fired James Comey's daughter, judge rules
items.description: Maurene Comey believes she was let go from her job as a federal prosecutor because her father is the former FBI director.

items.title: Anthropic warns of 'catastrophic risk' to humankind ahead of blockbuster share listing
items.description: The company will be the first true artificial intelligence company to go public as tech firms continue to invest heavily in AI.

items.title: Catholic bishops apologise for 'exploited' Trump meeting
items.description: Two bishops in images that show them praying with Trump have said they believed the meeting was private.

items.title: US Marine indicted for murder and robbery of woman in Japan
items.description: Prosecutors have indicted Devin Jacob Ballard for a killing that has caused outrage in Japan, local media reports.

items.title: Venezuelan opposition leader María Machado returns after months in exile
items.description: Machado had left the country just a month before the US government seized Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro.

items.title: 'Maxxing' selected as Dictionary.com word of the year

items.title: Algeria to send troops to Niger in first foreign deployment since 1973
items.description: The troops are expected to protect energy facilities in northern Niger, near the Libyan border.

items.title: Nurse killed in attack while responding to Ebola alert in DR Congo
items.description: Local youths reportedly accused the health workers of contaminating water sources and spreading Ebola.

items.title: More than 60 Christians killed in Ethiopia 'massacre', church official says
items.description: One resident, whose 75-year-old father was killed, described it as an ambush, saying they were surrounded.

items.title: Chris Brown given suspended eight-month prison sentence over nightclub attack
items.description: The R&B star previously pleaded guilty to affray, after attacking a music producer with a glass bottle.

items.description: The incident happened on Saturday night, close to an American football stadium where a game had just been played.

items.title: Australian murderer loses bid to eat Vegemite in prison

items.description: Bauza had voiced a number of characters in this summer's animated hit Coyote vs. Acme.

items.title: Part of Antarctica named after former BBC science correspondent

items.title: Crowds welcome Venezuela's María Machado after months in exile
items.description: The Venezuelan opposition leader spent more than 10 months in exile after escaping the country on a speedboat.

items.title: Why Israel's election is one of the most important in its history
